starting.card: Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself

description: This deck wins through battle damage, drains, and retrieval. RTP is a meta choice cuz pepl here are playing Hunt Down and BHBM. What I'm playing at TrinoCon next weekend.
cards: Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself
Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (Special Edition)
posted: I'm Here to Rescue You x2
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Start (11)': Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself ('RTP/You Suck Han'), Yavin 4: Massassi War Room, Yavin 4: Docking Bay, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Death Star: Detention Block Corridor, Prisoner 2187, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer, Staging Areas and Podrace Prep; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'D Detention Corridor' dested the Light Special Edition site Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (Special Edition) and 'DDB' the Light Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (the objective deploys both; the draft had Dark pages).

Posted 'Prison 2187' dested Prisoner 2187 (Leia imprisoned at Detention Block Corridor per the objective); 'Cap'n Han' dested Captain Han Solo; 'Chewie w/Gun' dested Chewie With Blaster Rifle; 'Lando w/Ax' dested Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Tat. Qui-Gon' dested the Tatooine-set Qui-Gon Jinn; 'Step' dested A Step Backward; 'TCFC' dested Too Close For Comfort; 'Ani's Racer' dested Anakin's Podracer; 'Qui-Gon's Stick' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; the Reflections III Qui-Gon's Lightsaber came out after this post).

The 'Characters (21)' section lists only 20 cards, so the deck totals 59 as published (section headers add up to 60). The strategy's update says the author had only 56 cards and planned to add Echo Base Garrison, Artoo and two locations, which are not in the list.
The 'Ships & Vehicles (6)' header line was removed.
The description says this is what the author planned to play at TrinoCon the following weekend; no result is given.
